# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Wednesday, November 4, 2026

*Wednesday edition, compiled before the market opens. Equity, index, rupee and flow numbers are Tuesday 3 November closes; gold spot and Brent are the latest prints. IBJA's 4 November AM rate had not been published when this was compiled, so the IBJA rows show Tuesday's PM rate. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed gold-loan lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Muthoot Finance (peer) discloses GST search at its registered office
Muthoot Finance Ltd, a separate listed company, told the exchanges late on 2 Nov that the GST Department ran a search under Section 67 of the CGST Act at its registered office from 29 Oct (about 11:00 IST) to 30 Oct (about 21:30 IST). The company said operations were unaffected and that it received the search mahasar on 2 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none directly, as the search concerns a different company; the disclosure coincides with the final days of Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCD issue.
Source: [NSE filing (Muthoot Finance)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MUTHOOTFIN_02112026202440_Reg_30_GST_SearchSD.pdf)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

### Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD bids stood at 2.36x with one day left
Bids for Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I public NCD stood at 2.36x the ₹200 crore base at 17:00 on 3 Nov, up from 2.18x on Monday; retail was at 2.14x, HNI 3.33x, NII 1.32x and institutional 0.01x. The issue closes on 5 Nov, with allotment due on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: HNI bids are above 3x while institutional bids are near zero, so the green-shoe portion is being taken up mainly by individual investors.
Source: [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)

| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf | 2026-11-03 |

### Business Today reads the Muthoot Fincorp DRHP: gold first, then wider secured lending
Business Today's 2 Nov review of the DRHP for the ₹3,000 crore fresh-issue IPO notes gold-loan AUM of ₹49,331.20 crore at 31 March 2026 (59.04% CAGR over two years) across 3,781 gold-loan branches. The company plans to grow loans against property, business loans and housing loans, and fee income rose from ₹211.59 crore in FY24 to ₹571.76 crore in FY26.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the press is framing the IPO as diversification beyond gold, so Q2 disclosures on the non-gold book are likely to be read against it.
Source: [Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/story/muthoot-fincorp-looks-beyond-gold-loans-with-rs3000-crore-ipo-565234-2026-11-02)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Sensex up 1.62% for a fourth straight gain; Nifty Financial Services up 1.84%
The Sensex closed at 76,917.85 on 3 Nov, up 1,225.07 points, and the Nifty 50 rose 1.58% to 23,810.85. Nifty Financial Services gained 1.84% to 25,357.90, and the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index rose 2.15%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: firmer financials provide a supportive backdrop for its NCD issue and IPO plans.
Source: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_03112026.csv)

### Gold-loan peers recover: Manappuram +1.99%, Muthoot Finance +0.54%; IIFL Finance −2.06%
On NSE, Manappuram Finance closed at ₹304.65 (+1.99%), Muthoot Finance (peer) at ₹2,528.20 (+0.54%) and IIFL Finance at ₹541.55 (−2.06%). Shriram Finance rose 2.48% to ₹884.80 and Bajaj Finance 1.10% to ₹970.00.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: listed gold lenders are steadying after Muthoot Finance's Stage 2 disclosure, a backdrop for secondary-market pricing of gold-lender debt.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_03112026.csv)

### Muthoot Microfin (subsidiary) up 4.00% ahead of its 5 Nov board meeting
Muthoot Microfin closed at ₹148.28 on 3 Nov, up ₹5.70 (4.00%). Its board meets on 5 Nov for Q2 results.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Fusion Finance's improved Q2 (below) sets the comparison for its microfinance subsidiary's results.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_03112026.csv)

### FIIs buy a provisional ₹6,836.81 crore, the year's biggest single day
Provisional exchange data show FIIs net bought ₹6,836.81 crore of Indian equities on 3 Nov while DIIs net sold ₹3,678.85 crore. CNBC-TV18 reports this as the largest single-day FII purchase of 2026.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: foreign flows returning to financials are supportive for the IPO window.
Source: [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-record-biggest-single-day-buying-of-2026-with-nearly-rs6900-crore-inflows-20026310.htm)

### Rupee firms 9 paise to 94.75; Brent settles at $103.60
PTI reports the rupee rose 9 paise to settle at 94.75 against the dollar on 3 Nov, its third straight gain. Brent for January delivery fell $1.17 (1.12%) to settle at $103.60 a barrel.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: cheaper oil eases the inflation case for further rate hikes, a factor in NBFC bank-funding costs.
Source: [ThePrint/PTI](https://theprint.in/economy/rupee-rises-9-paise-to-settle-at-94-75-against-us-dollar/3089655/)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### RBI amends FEMA export-import regulations
RBI published Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB dated 2 Nov 2026, the Second Amendment to the Export and Import of Goods and Services Regulations, in force from 1 Oct 2026. It covers foreign-exchange rules for exporters and importers, not NBFC lending.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none for lending.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13750&Mode=0)

### No new NBFC circular from RBI, SEBI or IBBI on 3 Nov
RBI's 3 Nov press releases were routine: VRRR auctions, state government security auction results and three November surveys. SEBI signed an MoU with Digital India BHASHINI and issued enforcement orders, none of them on NBFCs.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none today.
Source: [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/nov-2026/memorandum-of-understanding-between-securities-and-exchange-board-of-india-sebi-and-digital-india-bhashini-division-dibd-_105575.html)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

### Northern Arc Q2 PAT up 41% to ₹129 crore; lending AUM ₹19,003 crore
Northern Arc Capital's Q2 FY27 PAT rose 41% year on year to ₹129 crore and NII rose 32% to ₹425 crore. Lending AUM grew 34% to ₹19,003 crore, with credit cost at 2.55% and RoA at 2.82%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a diversified retail and MSME lender growing AUM at 34% with lower credit costs is a benchmark for non-gold growth at gold lenders.
Source: [NSE filing (Northern Arc)](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/NACL2020_03112026173910_Press_release_Q2_Sep2026_SD.pdf)

### Fusion Finance returns to profit at ₹86.5 crore; GNPA 1.6%
Microfinance lender Fusion Finance earned ₹86.5 crore in Q2, against ₹62.4 crore in Q1 and a ₹22.1 crore loss a year earlier. GNPA fell to 1.6%, AUM grew 14% to ₹8,007 crore and NIM widened to 12.5%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the microfinance recovery is showing in lender P&Ls ahead of Muthoot Microfin's 5 Nov results.
Source: [The Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/fusion-finance-swings-to-rs-86-5-crore-profit-as-asset-quality-improves/articleshow/135465579.cms)

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### Neo Alternatives closes second private credit fund at ₹6,200 crore
Neo Alternative Asset Managers reached final close of its second private credit fund at ₹6,200 crore, against a ₹5,000 crore target. The fund targets structured, collateral-backed financing for established businesses.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: private credit pools are growing alongside bank and NCD money, which widens the set of alternatives for mid-size lenders and their borrowers.
Source: [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/neo-raises-6200-cr-from-second-private-credit-fund/article71660275.ece)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

### Update: Meesho puts ₹399.99 crore into its lending-service subsidiary
Meesho took up 1.14 crore rights shares of Meesho Payments Pvt Ltd, its lending service provider, for ₹399.99 crore; the shares were allotted on 2 Nov. The subsidiary reported turnover of ₹11.05 crore and a net loss of ₹24.65 crore for 2025-26.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: platform-led credit for small-town buyers, a customer base gold lenders also serve, is getting funded.
Source: [BusinessLine/PTI](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/meesho-infuses-nearly-400-cr-in-lending-service-subsidiary-meesho-payments/article71659672.ece)

### NBFCs push festive personal loans with fee waivers and prizes
Moneycontrol reports that HDB Financial, Poonawalla Fincorp and Bajaj Finance are running Deepavali personal-loan campaigns, and HDB is giving a 1-gram gold coin daily to eligible gold-loan and other customers. CRIF data show NBFCs' share of personal-loan originations rose to 46% in Q1 from 40.5% a year earlier.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: HDB is using gold coins as a festive offer for gold-loan customers, competition in Muthoot Fincorp's core segment.
Source: [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/banks/nbfcs-accelerate-personal-loan-disbursement-with-festive-perks-14067328.html)

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

### Gold-loan stress shows at Shriram and Bajaj Finance too
ETBFSI reports that Shriram Finance's gold-loan Gross Stage 3 ratio rose to 3.12% in September from 2.57% in June, while Bajaj Finance's gold Stage 2 rose ₹1,047 crore on short-tenure schemes, of which ₹550 crore has since returned to Stage 1. Bajaj discontinued the short-tenure offering in August.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: several lenders now link gold-loan stress to post-April repayment structures, so analysts are likely to look for a Stage 2 split by product in Muthoot Fincorp's Q2.
Source: [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/gold-loan-boom-raises-early-signs-of-borrower-stress-at-nbfcs/135478275)

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance

### LIC Housing Finance targets GNPA of 1.9% after ₹553 crore of Q2 recoveries
LIC Housing Finance recovered ₹553 crore from its retail book in Q2 and ₹84 crore from written-off accounts, and GNPA was 2.05% at 30 September (2.51% a year earlier). MD Sandeep Kumar targets 1.9% by March and 14–15% disbursement growth, to ₹73,000–75,000 crore in FY27.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the largest HFC is chasing growth through retention and project loans, keeping prime home-loan pricing competitive for lenders growing housing books.
Source: [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/lic-housing-finance-assets-loans-companies-retail-portfolio-disbursements-11793676974950.html)

### HFC margins under pressure: LIC HFL raises its best rate 25 bps to 7.40%
LIC HFL's incremental borrowing cost is 6.91% against a cumulative 7.29%, and NIM was 2.58% in Q2 against 2.62% a year earlier. It raised lending rates 25 bps, taking the best prime home-loan rate from 7.15% to 7.40%, and keeps NIM guidance at 2.5–2.6%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: rate hikes are now reaching prime home-loan rates, which gives smaller lenders room to reprice LAP and home loans.
Source: [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/lic-housing-finance-assets-loans-companies-retail-portfolio-disbursements-11793676974950.html)

### ED registers PMLA case against Subhash Chandra on LIC HFL complaint
The Enforcement Directorate registered a PMLA case against Essel Group founder Subhash Chandra on 2 Nov, based on a CBI FIR arising from LIC HFL's complaint about two 2018 loans of ₹980 crore that turned non-performing. LIC HFL says it holds equivalent security; its admitted claim in Chandra's personal insolvency is ₹1,322.39 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the case highlights reliance on guarantor net-worth certificates in large secured loans, relevant to any lender's LAP and business-loan underwriting.
Source: [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/lic-housing-finance-assets-loans-companies-retail-portfolio-disbursements-11793676974950.html)

### HFC stocks: LIC Housing +1.95%, PNB Housing +0.25%, Bajaj Housing flat
On 3 Nov LIC Housing Finance closed at ₹504.95 (+1.95%), PNB Housing Finance at ₹1,063.00 (+0.25%) and Bajaj Housing Finance at ₹78.19 (+0.01%). HFCs lagged the 2.15% rise in the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: markets are pricing slower margins for housing lenders than for diversified NBFCs.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_03112026.csv)

> **Read for Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP lists housing loans and LAP among the secured lines it plans to grow. Today's HFC data show rising borrowing costs, a 25 bp rate hike by the largest HFC to protect NIM, and recoveries rather than growth carrying asset quality.

reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Wednesday, 4 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

### RBI amends FEMA export-import regulations (Second Amendment, 2026)
RBI published Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB dated 2 Nov 2026, the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026. It amends the principal regulations of 13 Jan 2026 and is stated to come into force from 1 Oct 2026.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none expected, as the amendment concerns export-import transactions rather than domestic lending.
Reference: FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB · Addressed to: exporters, importers and authorised dealer banks (FEMA regulations) · Issued: 2 Nov 2026 · Effective: 1 Oct 2026
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13750&Mode=0)

### No new NBFC circular from RBI, SEBI or IBBI on 3 Nov
RBI's notification feed has nothing after the FEMA amendment, and its 3 Nov press releases are routine market operations. SEBI's only 3 Nov items are an MoU with Digital India BHASHINI and enforcement orders; IBBI has nothing after 30 Oct.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none today.

cards.title: Muthoot Finance (peer) discloses GST search at its registered office
cards.summary: Muthoot Finance Ltd, a separate listed company, told the exchanges late on 2 Nov that the GST Department ran a search under Section 67 of the CGST Act at its registered office from 29 Oct (about 11:00 IST) to 30 Oct (about 21:30 IST). The company said operations were unaffected and that it received the search mahasar on 2 Nov. Source: NSE filing (Muthoot Finance)
cards.impact: none directly, as the search concerns a different company; the disclosure coincides with the final days of Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCD issue.

cards.title: Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD bids stood at 2.36x with one day left
cards.summary: Bids for Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I public NCD stood at 2.36x the ₹200 crore base at 17:00 on 3 Nov, up from 2.18x on Monday; retail was at 2.14x, HNI 3.33x, NII 1.32x and institutional 0.01x. The issue closes on 5 Nov, with allotment due on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov. Source: Chittorgarh Field Value As of Status Open, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026 (Chittorgarh) 2026-11-03 Size ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf 2026-11-03 Rating…
cards.impact: HNI bids are above 3x while institutional bids are near zero, so the green-shoe portion is being taken up mainly by individual investors.

cards.title: Business Today reads the Muthoot Fincorp DRHP: gold first, then wider secured lending
cards.summary: Business Today's 2 Nov review of the DRHP for the ₹3,000 crore fresh-issue IPO notes gold-loan AUM of ₹49,331.20 crore at 31 March 2026 (59.04% CAGR over two years) across 3,781 gold-loan branches. The company plans to grow loans against property, business loans and housing loans, and fee income rose from ₹211.59 crore in FY24 to ₹571.76 crore in FY26.
cards.impact: the press is framing the IPO as diversification beyond gold, so Q2 disclosures on the non-gold book are likely to be read against it.

cards.title: Sensex up 1.62% for a fourth straight gain; Nifty Financial Services up 1.84%
cards.summary: The Sensex closed at 76,917.85 on 3 Nov, up 1,225.07 points, and the Nifty 50 rose 1.58% to 23,810.85. Nifty Financial Services gained 1.84% to 25,357.90, and the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index rose 2.15%.
cards.impact: firmer financials provide a supportive backdrop for its NCD issue and IPO plans.

cards.title: Gold-loan peers recover: Manappuram +1.99%, Muthoot Finance +0.54%; IIFL Finance −2.06%
cards.summary: On NSE, Manappuram Finance closed at ₹304.65 (+1.99%), Muthoot Finance (peer) at ₹2,528.20 (+0.54%) and IIFL Finance at ₹541.55 (−2.06%). Shriram Finance rose 2.48% to ₹884.80 and Bajaj Finance 1.10% to ₹970.00.
cards.impact: listed gold lenders are steadying after Muthoot Finance's Stage 2 disclosure, a backdrop for secondary-market pricing of gold-lender debt.

cards.title: Muthoot Microfin (subsidiary) up 4.00% ahead of its 5 Nov board meeting
cards.summary: Muthoot Microfin closed at ₹148.28 on 3 Nov, up ₹5.70 (4.00%). Its board meets on 5 Nov for Q2 results.
cards.impact: Fusion Finance's improved Q2 (below) sets the comparison for its microfinance subsidiary's results.

cards.title: FIIs buy a provisional ₹6,836.81 crore, the year's biggest single day
cards.summary: Provisional exchange data show FIIs net bought ₹6,836.81 crore of Indian equities on 3 Nov while DIIs net sold ₹3,678.85 crore. CNBC-TV18 reports this as the largest single-day FII purchase of 2026.
cards.impact: foreign flows returning to financials are supportive for the IPO window.

cards.title: Rupee firms 9 paise to 94.75; Brent settles at $103.60
cards.summary: PTI reports the rupee rose 9 paise to settle at 94.75 against the dollar on 3 Nov, its third straight gain. Brent for January delivery fell $1.17 (1.12%) to settle at $103.60 a barrel.
cards.impact: cheaper oil eases the inflation case for further rate hikes, a factor in NBFC bank-funding costs.

cards.title: RBI amends FEMA export-import regulations
cards.summary: RBI published Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB dated 2 Nov 2026, the Second Amendment to the Export and Import of Goods and Services Regulations, in force from 1 Oct 2026. It covers foreign-exchange rules for exporters and importers, not NBFC lending.
cards.impact: none for lending.

cards.title: Northern Arc Q2 PAT up 41% to ₹129 crore; lending AUM ₹19,003 crore
cards.summary: Northern Arc Capital's Q2 FY27 PAT rose 41% year on year to ₹129 crore and NII rose 32% to ₹425 crore. Lending AUM grew 34% to ₹19,003 crore, with credit cost at 2.55% and RoA at 2.82%.
cards.impact: a diversified retail and MSME lender growing AUM at 34% with lower credit costs is a benchmark for non-gold growth at gold lenders.

cards.title: Fusion Finance returns to profit at ₹86.5 crore; GNPA 1.6%
cards.summary: Microfinance lender Fusion Finance earned ₹86.5 crore in Q2, against ₹62.4 crore in Q1 and a ₹22.1 crore loss a year earlier. GNPA fell to 1.6%, AUM grew 14% to ₹8,007 crore and NIM widened to 12.5%.
cards.impact: the microfinance recovery is showing in lender P&Ls ahead of Muthoot Microfin's 5 Nov results.

cards.title: Neo Alternatives closes second private credit fund at ₹6,200 crore
cards.summary: Neo Alternative Asset Managers reached final close of its second private credit fund at ₹6,200 crore, against a ₹5,000 crore target. The fund targets structured, collateral-backed financing for established businesses.
cards.impact: private credit pools are growing alongside bank and NCD money, which widens the set of alternatives for mid-size lenders and their borrowers.

cards.title: Update: Meesho puts ₹399.99 crore into its lending-service subsidiary
cards.summary: Meesho took up 1.14 crore rights shares of Meesho Payments Pvt Ltd, its lending service provider, for ₹399.99 crore; the shares were allotted on 2 Nov. The subsidiary reported turnover of ₹11.05 crore and a net loss of ₹24.65 crore for 2025-26. Source: BusinessLine/PTI
cards.impact: platform-led credit for small-town buyers, a customer base gold lenders also serve, is getting funded.

cards.title: NBFCs push festive personal loans with fee waivers and prizes
cards.summary: Moneycontrol reports that HDB Financial, Poonawalla Fincorp and Bajaj Finance are running Deepavali personal-loan campaigns, and HDB is giving a 1-gram gold coin daily to eligible gold-loan and other customers. CRIF data show NBFCs' share of personal-loan originations rose to 46% in Q1 from 40.5% a year earlier.
cards.impact: HDB is using gold coins as a festive offer for gold-loan customers, competition in Muthoot Fincorp's core segment.

cards.title: Gold-loan stress shows at Shriram and Bajaj Finance too
cards.summary: ETBFSI reports that Shriram Finance's gold-loan Gross Stage 3 ratio rose to 3.12% in September from 2.57% in June, while Bajaj Finance's gold Stage 2 rose ₹1,047 crore on short-tenure schemes, of which ₹550 crore has since returned to Stage 1. Bajaj discontinued the short-tenure offering in August.
cards.impact: several lenders now link gold-loan stress to post-April repayment structures, so analysts are likely to look for a Stage 2 split by product in Muthoot Fincorp's Q2.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance
cards.title: LIC Housing Finance targets GNPA of 1.9% after ₹553 crore of Q2 recoveries
cards.summary: LIC Housing Finance recovered ₹553 crore from its retail book in Q2 and ₹84 crore from written-off accounts, and GNPA was 2.05% at 30 September (2.51% a year earlier). MD Sandeep Kumar targets 1.9% by March and 14–15% disbursement growth, to ₹73,000–75,000 crore in FY27.
cards.impact: the largest HFC is chasing growth through retention and project loans, keeping prime home-loan pricing competitive for lenders growing housing books.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance
cards.title: HFC margins under pressure: LIC HFL raises its best rate 25 bps to 7.40%
cards.summary: LIC HFL's incremental borrowing cost is 6.91% against a cumulative 7.29%, and NIM was 2.58% in Q2 against 2.62% a year earlier. It raised lending rates 25 bps, taking the best prime home-loan rate from 7.15% to 7.40%, and keeps NIM guidance at 2.5–2.6%.
cards.impact: rate hikes are now reaching prime home-loan rates, which gives smaller lenders room to reprice LAP and home loans.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance
cards.title: ED registers PMLA case against Subhash Chandra on LIC HFL complaint
cards.summary: The Enforcement Directorate registered a PMLA case against Essel Group founder Subhash Chandra on 2 Nov, based on a CBI FIR arising from LIC HFL's complaint about two 2018 loans of ₹980 crore that turned non-performing. LIC HFL says it holds equivalent security; its admitted claim in Chandra's personal insolvency is ₹1,322.39 crore.
cards.impact: the case highlights reliance on guarantor net-worth certificates in large secured loans, relevant to any lender's LAP and business-loan underwriting.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Wednesday: Housing finance
cards.title: HFC stocks: LIC Housing +1.95%, PNB Housing +0.25%, Bajaj Housing flat
cards.summary: On 3 Nov LIC Housing Finance closed at ₹504.95 (+1.95%), PNB Housing Finance at ₹1,063.00 (+0.25%) and Bajaj Housing Finance at ₹78.19 (+0.01%). HFCs lagged the 2.15% rise in the Nifty Financial Services Ex-Bank index.
cards.impact: markets are pricing slower margins for housing lenders than for diversified NBFCs.
